assumptions.statement: The target problem exists and is severe
assumptions.falsification_condition: Independent sources show the problem is rare or immaterial
assumptions.validation_condition: At least two independent non-model sources quantify repeated pain

assumptions.statement: An identifiable buyer owns the problem
assumptions.falsification_condition: No role owns budget or accountability
assumptions.validation_condition: A named role owns budget and the relevant outcome

assumptions.statement: The buyer is willing to pay
assumptions.falsification_condition: Observed behavior rejects the viable price range
assumptions.validation_condition: Primary or observed evidence supports the price range

assumptions.statement: The buyer is reachable through a repeatable digital channel
assumptions.falsification_condition: No compliant repeatable channel reaches the buyer
assumptions.validation_condition: A measurable digital channel reaches the buyer

assumptions.statement: The product is technically feasible
assumptions.falsification_condition: A required capability cannot meet the quality threshold
assumptions.validation_condition: A bounded prototype or primary technical evidence meets it

assumptions.statement: At least 90% of delivery can be automated
assumptions.falsification_condition: Human work scales linearly with customers
assumptions.validation_condition: Automation design keeps marginal human work sublinear

assumptions.statement: Marginal human burden stays low at 10x scale
assumptions.falsification_condition: Human minutes per customer do not decrease at 10x
assumptions.validation_condition: Estimated human minutes per customer decrease at 10x

assumptions.statement: Unit economics can sustain the delivery model
assumptions.falsification_condition: Conservative gross margin is structurally negative
assumptions.validation_condition: Conservative costs support positive gross margin

assumptions.statement: Substitutes do not erase the value proposition
assumptions.falsification_condition: An existing substitute is cheaper and equally effective
assumptions.validation_condition: Evidence shows a material underserved gap

assumptions.statement: The product can retain a defensible advantage
assumptions.falsification_condition: Capabilities are immediately commoditized with no wedge
assumptions.validation_condition: A data, workflow, distribution, or trust wedge persists

assumptions.statement: The product can operate compliantly
assumptions.falsification_condition: Official rules prohibit the delivery model
assumptions.validation_condition: Official sources support a compliant operating path

assumptions.statement: A verifiable why-now catalyst exists
assumptions.falsification_condition: The claimed catalyst is absent or already reversed
assumptions.validation_condition: Dated evidence supports a current catalyst
